inventory.visualPurpose: The Confidence interval block with its significance-rules panel (book 267 upper): the definition (range of values within which the true mean of the population is expected to fall, with a specified probability), the level rule CI = 1 – α with the 95% convention, the formula CI for sample mean = x ± Z(SE), the Z constants 1.96 (95%) and 2.58 (99%), the sample-size narrowing rule, and the six mirrored verdict rules (excludes/includes 0 for mean differences, excludes/includes 1 for OR/RR, non-overlap/overlap between two groups) — the estimate side of the chapter's inference story
inventory.sourceFigureDescription: PURE TEXT, no raster (pdfimages: zero raster images; VLM-read in TWO passes — 120dpi full page + 300dpi upper crop, staging-pubh15/vlm-census.txt): the bold dark-navy heading 'Confidence interval' in the left label column with the body text right of it (definition; 'CI = 1 – α. The 95% CI (corresponding to α = 0.05) is often used. As sample size increases, CI narrows.'; 'CI for sample mean = x ± Z(SE)' with the sample-mean x printed with an OVERBAR and the ± as a true plus-minus; 'For the 95% CI, Z = 1.96.'; 'For the 99% CI, Z = 2.58.'), and BESIDE it in the same vertical band (upper-right; bbox x≈421–612 vs the CI body x≈199–380) a BORDERLESS rules panel with small light-teal filled-square bullets and H0 with a subscript zero: 'H0 is rejected (and results are significant) when:' + '95% CI for mean difference excludes 0' + '95% CI OR or RR excludes 1' + 'CIs between two groups do not overlap', then 'H0 is not rejected (and results are not significant)' / 'when:' (the lead-in wraps, 'when:' alone on its own line) + the three mirror bullets (includes 0, includes 1, do overlap). The panel extracts AFTER the Meta-analysis body in the raw text stream (reading-order jumble; print position pinned by bbox + VLM). NO figure prints anywhere in the upper portion (both VLM passes explicit: no curve, distribution, error bars, forest plot, or icons) — the brief's possible distribution figure beside the CI block was NOT found.
inventory.kypLocation: Zone A + Zone B of the registry visual (CiMetaMap in visuals/pubhealth-p15.tsx): Zone A the formula card (the printed definition and level rule, the big x̄ ± Z(SE) with a drawn overbar, the two Z-constant chips, the small-n/large-n narrowing dial, and the number line with the 95% bracket sitting inside the wider 99% bracket around the x̄ tick) and Zone B the six verdict rules as mirrored number-line glyphs (green rejected column: brackets excluding the null ticks 0 and 1, two disjoint group brackets; warning not-rejected column: brackets straddling the nulls, two overlapping group brackets) plus the KYP null-value router strip — every printed word preserved verbatim; all number-line geometry is KYP's. inventory.visualPurpose: The Meta-analysis block (book 267 upper, full width below a thin rule): a method of statistical analysis that pools summary data (eg, means, RRs) from multiple studies for a more precise estimate of the size of an effect; also estimates heterogeneity of effect sizes between studies; improves power, strength of evidence, and generalizability (external validity) of study findings; limited by quality of individual studies and bias in study selection — the evidence pyramid's pooling layer
inventory.sourceFigureDescription: PURE TEXT, no raster (pdfimages: zero raster images; VLM-read in two passes, staging-pubh15/vlm-census.txt): the bold dark-navy heading 'Meta-analysis' in the left label column below a thin horizontal rule, with three body sentences printed full-width in plain black text (no bold lead-ins, no colored text): 'A method of statistical analysis that pools summary data (eg, means, RRs) from multiple studies for a more precise estimate of the size of an effect. Also estimates heterogeneity of effect sizes between studies.' / 'Improves power, strength of evidence, and generalizability (external validity) of study findings.' / 'Limited by quality of individual studies and bias in study selection.' 'eg' prints without periods (First Aid house style); the wraps are clean. NO figure prints with the block (both VLM passes: no forest plot, no icons — the area is pure text).
inventory.kypLocation: Zone C of the registry visual (CiMetaMap in visuals/pubhealth-p15.tsx): the pooling diagram — three KYP study cards (summary RR/mean estimates, each with a wide interval) converging by arrows into one POOLED ESTIMATE card carrying a visibly narrower interval ('a more precise estimate of the size of an effect'), the heterogeneity chip ('Also estimates heterogeneity of effect sizes between studies.'), the gains chip ('Improves power, strength of evidence, and generalizability (external validity) of study findings.'), the limits chip ('Limited by quality of individual studies and bias in study selection.'), and the KYP bridge strip tying pooling to the printed narrowing rule; every quoted sentence is the print's own, the pooling geometry and the three study cards are KYP's. The full text is ALSO carried verbatim in the note's table block (blocks[1]), core.what, mechanisms[1], and recall[6-7]
